timing_scope: task/config loading through public loader; final report/completion write excluded; outer benchmark includes them
scope: M1 local integration; uncalibrated, development only, not a production throughput benchmark

analysis.training_eligibility_reason: calibration and independent validation not completed

dataset.split_method: SHA256 of family_id; target proportions 70/15/15, not balanced on small sets
dataset.identity_policy: all derived variants/retries/windows must inherit the originating family_id before splitting
dataset.missing_family_policy: retained, unassigned, ineligible; never infer family from run_id
dataset.training_input: episodes/<run_id>/observations.csv only: ENU position/velocity and valid mask; group by t_s and agent_id
dataset.privileged_outputs: task, reference, truth, labels and metadata must not be fed as observation features
dataset.limitation: uncalibrated M1 airborne mission baseline; no independent sensor, FCU or whole-flight validation

counterfactual_completeness.expectation_source: exported intents plus provided generation attempts/accepted families

source.observation_dependency: ideal observation derived from plant; no independent sensor/estimator
source.git_identity_scope: baseline only; source_sha256 binds uncommitted implementation contents

diagnostics.peak_scope: retained support samples, jerk constant within each support interval
diagnostics.phase_release_policy: dense common-time barrier after all actual holds
diagnostics.support_policy: all integrator endpoints plus cubic region intersections and arrival/hold boundaries

audit.topology_scope: signature overlap is reported separately per intent/control_mode; no cross-intent signature matching
audit.limitation: descriptive audit only; no classifier, accuracy or intention identifiability claim; optional evidence is never recomputed
